subject: any ideas on adjusting size of points that fall on x axis grid lines?

messages.author: 7b0760bc53a3b2c1
messages.subject: any ideas on adjusting size of points that fall on x axis grid lines?
parts:
I am rather new to R, having mostly used stata but I am getting to
learn (and enjoy) the quality of graphs I can get using the ggplot
package.


I have been trying to plot a "boxplot" and "jitter" plot while
adjusting for the size using the following command:

qplot(enzymes,relative_compound_x_expression,geom=c("boxplot","jitter"),
size=I(0.9))

The plot comes up fine but I realise that any points of the jitter
plot that fall on grid lines along the x axis don't get adjusted in
size.

I am not sure why this is the case. I would appreciate any help.

DanielHO

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: any ideas on adjusting size of points that fall on x axis grid lines?
parts:
The points that aren't smaller are the outliers from geom_boxplot. 

geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "NA")


will get rid of them. 


As an example... 


ggplot(data=iris, aes(x=Species, y=Sepal.Length))+geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "NA")+ geom_jitter(size=I(0.9))



Brandon
